Aquaculture AI: growth, mortality, disease and harvest prediction, feed optimisation policy, ML.NET and ONNX Runtime backends and an LLM aquaculture agent with grounded tool calls.

Computer vision for aquaculture: YOLO/ONNX detection with NMS, shrimp and fish disease detection (WSSV, EMS, EHP, gill disease, fin rot, ulcer), counting and length/weight estimation, OpenCvSharp interop.
Fisheries stock assessment inspired by FLR, FSA and TropFishR: Schaefer/Fox surplus production, Beverton–Holt, yield per recruit, MSY, length-based methods and Kobe status.
Feed management: FCR, species feeding tables, meal schedules, feed cost analysis, least-cost feed selection and blending, auto-feeding recommendations.
Native (Rust) high-performance kernels for AquaCulture.Net: advection-diffusion, water chemistry batches, statistics and Monte-Carlo growth, with an automatic managed fallback.
Forecasting: Holt, Holt–Winters, AR (Yule–Walker), dawn dissolved-oxygen crash forecast and Monte-Carlo harvest forecasting (P10/P50/P90).
Water quality for aquaculture: 15 parameters, unionized ammonia, DO saturation, species-aware WQI and CCME index, alert engine and recommendation engine.
Real-time digital pond and farm twin: sensors, biomass, water quality, feed consumption, disease status and weather impact with explained decisions and what-if simulation.
Blazor UI components for AquaCulture.Net: PondMap, WaterChart, FeedScheduler, SensorGrid, GISViewer, DigitalTwinViewer (Three.js 3D pond), gauges and KPI cards.
AquaGrowth engine: TGC, von Bertalanffy and Gompertz models with temperature/DO/ammonia/density modifiers, daily cycle simulation, biomass, mortality, harvest date and yield prediction.
Population dynamics: recruitment (Beverton–Holt, Ricker), mortality, spawning, migration, harvest, predation (Holling II) and Leslie matrix projection.
Aquaculture IoT: devices (ESP32, ESP8266, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, PLC), MQTT, LoRaWAN (Cayenne LPP), Modbus RTU/TCP, REST and OPC-UA mapping, edge analytics and sensor simulation.
UI-agnostic visualisation: colour maps, PNG encoder, SVG charts (line, bar, gauge, heatmap) and pond/farm maps.
AquaCulture.Net core: species database, farm/pond/cycle domain model, units, statistics, time series, geo types, optimisation, DI and event bus.
Aquaculture disease knowledge base (WSSV, AHPND/EMS, EHP, IMNV, gill disease, fin rot, ulcer, streptococcosis, TiLV…), Bayesian symptom diagnosis and environmental risk.

dotnet new templates for AquaCulture.Net: console pond advisor, Blazor farm dashboard, IoT edge gateway (MQTT + digital twin) and Avalonia desktop pond monitor. Made by Gravicode Studios, led by Kang Fadhil.
Hydrodynamic and mass-balance simulation: 2-D advection–diffusion of oxygen, temperature and waste, paddle-wheel/river/tidal flows, sedimentation, pond oxygen budget and RAS mass balance.
Aquaculture analytics: FCR, SR, ABW, ADG, SGR, biomass, productivity, profit, mortality and Water Health Index KPIs, cycle economics and benchmarking.
Reporting: Excel (XLSX), PDF, Word (DOCX), CSV, JSON, HTML and Markdown writers with no external dependencies, plus GAP, CBIB, ASC and BAP compliance audits.
Environment and weather: observations, Open-Meteo client, deterministic tropical weather generator, weather impact predictor and climate risk analysis for ponds, cages and RAS.
